title: I have done (present perfect) and I did (past simple)
summary: Когда говорить **I have done** (связь с настоящим, время не названо), а когда **I did** (закончившееся время: yesterday, last year, ago).
ru:
## Главное правило
- Если названо **законченное время** (yesterday, last week, in 2010, two days ago, when ...?) — **past simple**.
- Если время не названо, а важна связь с настоящим (результат, опыт, «до сих пор») — **present perfect**.
> I **lost** my key yesterday. — Я потеряла ключ вчера. (past simple, время названо)
> I **have lost** my key. — Я потеряла ключ. (и его до сих пор нет)

## Past simple — закончившееся время
Слова: **yesterday, last night, last week, in 2015, on Monday, two days ago, when**.
> We **went** to Turkey last summer. — Мы ездили в Турцию прошлым летом.
> **When did** you **arrive**? — Когда ты приехала?
- ~~When have you arrived?~~ → When **did** you arrive?
- ~~I have seen him yesterday.~~ → I **saw** him yesterday.

## Present perfect — до сих пор / результат
> **Have** you ever **been** to Spain? — Ты когда-нибудь бывала в Испании? (в жизни)
> The letter **hasn't arrived** yet. — Письмо ещё не пришло.
> We **have lived** here for six years. — Мы живём здесь шесть лет (и сейчас живём).
> Bill **has gone** home. — Билл ушёл домой (его здесь нет).

## Сравнение пар
| present perfect | past simple |
|---|---|
| I've lost my key. (нет сейчас) | I lost my key last week. |
| Have you seen Ann? (где она?) | Did you see Ann on Saturday? |
| We've lived here for six years. (живём сейчас) | We lived in Glasgow for six years. (раньше, теперь нет) |

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have been there in 2019.~~ → I **was** there in 2019.
- ~~She has called me two hours ago.~~ → She **called** me two hours ago.
- ~~We haven't had a holiday last year.~~ → We **didn't have** a holiday last year.
en:
## The main rule
- With a **finished time** (yesterday, last week, in 2010, two days ago, when ...?) we use the **past simple**.
- When the time is not given and we think about now (result, experience, "until now") we use the **present perfect**.
> I **lost** my key yesterday. (past simple, finished time)
> I **have lost** my key. (I still can't find it)

## Past simple: finished time
Words: **yesterday, last night, last week, in 2015, on Monday, two days ago, when**.
> We **went** to Turkey last summer.
> **When did** you **arrive**?
- ~~When have you arrived?~~ → When **did** you arrive?
- ~~I have seen him yesterday.~~ → I **saw** him yesterday.

## Present perfect: until now / result
> **Have** you ever **been** to Spain? (in your life)
> The letter **hasn't arrived** yet.
> We **have lived** here for six years. (and we still live here)
> Bill **has gone** home. (he isn't here now)

## Compare
| present perfect | past simple |
|---|---|
| I've lost my key. | I lost my key last week. |
| Have you seen Ann? | Did you see Ann on Saturday? |
| We've lived here for six years. | We lived in Glasgow for six years. |

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have been there in 2019.~~ → I **was** there in 2019.
- ~~She has called me two hours ago.~~ → She **called** me two hours ago.
- ~~We haven't had a holiday last year.~~ → We **didn't have** a holiday last year.
structure:
## Что выбрать
| Сигнальные слова | Время |
|---|---|
| yesterday, last week, in 2010, ago, when, what time | **past simple** |
| ever, never, yet, already, just, for, since, how long | **present perfect** |
| today, this week (период ещё идёт) | present perfect |

## Формы
| | past simple | present perfect |
|---|---|---|
| + | I saw Tom. | I have seen Tom. |
| − | I didn't see Tom. | I haven't seen Tom. |
| ? | Did you see Tom? | Have you seen Tom? |

## Формула
> **Past simple** + законченное время (**yesterday / ago / in 2015**)
> **have / has + past participle** + без точного времени или **ever / yet / for / since**
